decisions.reason: As an upgraded and renamed version of an already accepted screen, it carries visible prior investment and customer recognition, so management is inclined to continue rather than reverse course.
The AK series was still being publicly updated to EU Stage V in 2019, which signals a strong strategic and reputational commitment that a German machinery maker would be reluctant to abandon quickly.

Although the evidence of market traction is less explicit than for some other products, giving it its own page suggests growing commitment, and management can plausibly treat any weaker results as temporary.
The CERON line was presented as setting benchmarks in its segment and remained prominently featured, so sunk development costs and strong public claims make continuation the more likely choice.
